listing.name: Yo-kai Watch 4++ (YW4Recomp)
listing.summary: This Windows port targets Yo-kai Watch 4++ update 2.2.0. Build it from your own extracted files. The project reports starting a game, visiting the house and town, and autosaving. Effects are missing and later areas can crash.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use hash-checked ExeFS and RomFS for the 4++ 2.2.0 update. The original Yo-kai Watch 4 requires a different profile. The root guide has no separate instructions for keys or firmware.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s Windows x64 source build with Python, Git, Clang, GCC and the Vulkan SDK. The player needs Vulkan 1.3. There is no release package.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports 30 FPS in early areas. The Linux badge describes a planned route and has no Linux test behind it. No Mac route is documented.
